tools.name: GetDebugState
tools.description: Returns the current debugger state: whether a binary is loaded, whether it is running or paused, the PID, current instruction pointer, and current module. Always available. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: LoadBinary
tools.description: Loads an executable into the debugger for a new debugging session. Equivalent to File > Open in the GUI. If a session is already active it is terminated first. The debuggee pauses at the system breakpoint.

filePath.description: Absolute file path of the executable to debug.

tools.name: ExecuteDebuggerCommand
tools.description: Executes an arbitrary x64dbg command string. Example: ExecuteDebuggerCommand command=run

tools.name: ListCommandsByCategory
tools.description: Lists the available MCP tools, optionally filtered to a single category.

tools.name: SearchForStrings
tools.description: Searches process memory for a specific text string and returns the addresses where it occurs.

searchText.description: The literal text to search for.

tools.name: GetEventLog
tools.description: Returns the last N debugger events (exceptions, breakpoints, DLL loads, thread events, etc.). Keeps the last 64 events in a ring buffer. Use this to see what happened in x64dbg.

count.description: Number of most recent events to return (default: all, max 64).

tools.name: ClearEventLog
tools.description: Clears the event log ring buffer.

tools.name: EvalExpression
tools.description: Evaluates an x64dbg expression (address, register, arithmetic, symbol) and returns the result in hex and decimal.

tools.name: AttachProcess
tools.description: Attaches the debugger to a running process by PID.

tools.name: Echo
tools.description: Echoes the input back to the client.
